_comment: Pinned top-10 for seven queries over tests/fixtures/knowledge_corpus.json. Rebuilt ONLY when the ranking is intended to change: it goes red when chunking, the tokenizer, the QUERY CONNECTIVE, the ORDER BY or the fixture corpus move, which are exactly the things that silently alter every downstream recall number. Plan 02's chunker sweep changes the module default, not the params recorded here, so it cannot move this. 'Marrowgate Zephyrine' was added in the M3 fix because the other six cannot discriminate the connective: their rankings are byte-identical under AND and under OR, so the semantics change that moved the real-corpus recall@10 from 0.1429 to 0.8099 passed this fixture in silence.
